changeSet.author: zejaven
changeSet.sql: UPDATE cashflow.recurring_rule SET amount_strategy = 'AVERAGE' WHERE amount_strategy = 'AVERAGE_PERIOD'
ALTER TABLE cashflow.recurring_rule DROP CONSTRAINT chk_recurring_rule_strategy
ALTER TABLE cashflow.recurring_rule ADD CONSTRAINT chk_recurring_rule_strategy CHECK (amount_strategy IN ('FIXED', 'AVERAGE'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE cashflow.recurring_rule DROP CONSTRAINT chk_recurring_rule_strategy
ALTER TABLE cashflow.recurring_rule ADD CONSTRAINT chk_recurring_rule_strategy CHECK (amount_strategy IN ('FIXED', 'AVERAGE', 'AVERAGE_PERIOD'))
